description: This file defines the 'fsnotify' package, providing a cross-platform interface for file system notifications. It includes the 'Watcher' struct, 'Event' and 'Op' types, constants for file operations, and functions for creating and managing watchers, as well as platform-specific notes and configuration options.

classes.name: Watcher
classes.description: Watches a set of filesystem paths and delivers events and errors via channels.

classes.name: Event
classes.description: Represents a filesystem notification event, including the path, operation, and optional rename source.

classes.name: Op
classes.description: Bitmask representing filesystem operations such as create, write, remove, rename, and chmod.

methods.name: NewWatcher
methods.description: Creates a new filesystem watcher with default buffer size.

methods.name: NewBufferedWatcher
methods.description: Creates a new filesystem watcher with a specified buffer size.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Starts monitoring a specified path for filesystem events.

methods.name: AddWith
methods.description: Starts monitoring a path with additional options.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Removes all watches and closes the watcher.

methods.name: WatchList
methods.description: Returns all paths currently being watched.

methods.name: xSupports
methods.description: Checks if specific operations are supported on the platform.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the Op bitmask.

methods.name: Has
methods.description: Checks if an Op bitmask includes a specific operation.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the Event, including path and operation.
